gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Denon PMA-600NE's optical and coaxial inputs take only linear PCM, with Denon's warning that a Dolby Digital, DTS or AAC signal from a TV 'causes noise and could damage the speakers', while the WiiM Amp Pro's HDMI ARC and optical inputs accept Dolby Digital as well as PCM.
standout_why: I compared against recordplayeradvice.com (Denon PMA-600NE vs Yamaha A-S301), hifiaudiosource.com (Yamaha A-S301 vs Denon PMA-600NE) and stylusandsound.com/best-stereo-amplifiers. Recordplayeradvice says the Denon has a '192kHz/24-bit DAC with optical and coaxial inputs, for a TV or CD player' but never says the inputs are PCM-only. Hifiaudiosource only counts the inputs ('2 optical + 1 coaxial') and does not say how a TV connects. Stylusandsound covers only the base WiiM Amp, not the Amp Pro, and says nothing about TV audio formats. Rivals already say the WiiM has no phono stage, both Denon and Yamaha are MM-only, and the Denon has Analog Mode, so none of those count as new. The whathifi.com best-buys page came back as a headline only, so I could not check it.
decides: This matters for the shopper who also wants TV sound, one of the uses ChatGPT offered. The WiiM Amp Pro takes the TV's Dolby Digital directly over HDMI ARC or optical. On the Denon PMA-600NE, the TV's digital audio output has to be set to PCM, or the result is noise and a risk to the speakers. That supports ChatGPT's 'TV and music' pitch for the WiiM Amp Pro. A Denon recommendation for TV use needs a 'set the TV to PCM' note. Don't apply the WiiM finding to the cheaper base WiiM Amp, which WiiM says is PCM-only.

findings.label: Signals the optical and coaxial digital inputs accept
findings.value: Linear PCM only, at 32, 44.1, 48, 88.2, 96, 176.4 or 192 kHz
findings.source_title: Denon PMA-600NE online manual: Connecting to a device with digital audio output connectors
findings.note: Denon's own manual says: 'Linear PCM signals with a sampling frequency of 32 kHz, 44.1 kHz, 48 kHz, 88.2 kHz, 96 kHz, 176.4 kHz, or 192 kHz' can be input. This is the EU English edition. I did not open the US edition.

findings.label: Denon's warning about Dolby Digital, DTS and AAC on the digital inputs
findings.value: "Do not input non-PCM signals, such as Dolby Digital, DTS and AAC. This causes noise and could damage the speakers."
findings.source_title: Denon PMA-600NE online manual: Connecting to a device with digital audio output connectors
findings.note: Exact quote from the manual. In practice the TV's digital audio output must be set to PCM, not bitstream or Dolby passthrough, before it feeds this amp.

findings.label: Formats the HDMI ARC and optical inputs accept
findings.value: PCM and Dolby Digital, up to 24-bit/192 kHz; no Dolby Atmos or DTS
findings.source_title: How to Use Audio Input Ports of the WiiM Amp or WiiM Amp Pro (WiiM support)
findings.note: WiiM's support article lists PCM and Dolby Digital for the Amp Pro's HDMI ARC and optical inputs, and says 'neither the WiiM Amp nor the WiiM Amp Pro supports other TV audio formats like Dolby Atmos or DTS.'

findings.label: Formats the HDMI ARC and optical inputs accept (base model, not the Pro)
findings.source_title: How to Use Audio Input Ports of the WiiM Amp or WiiM Amp Pro (WiiM support)
findings.note: The same WiiM article separates the two models: the base Amp is PCM-only and the Pro adds Dolby Digital. Copy that cites the Amp Pro's Dolby support should not be reused for the base Amp.

unsourced: Whether the Yamaha A-S301's optical and coaxial inputs are PCM-only. Yamaha's US spec page and every Yamaha-hosted copy of the owner's manual I tried (usa.yamaha.com, it.yamaha.com, mx.yamaha.com) returned HTTP 403. The Adorama copy of the manual could not be read as text. Only hifi-wiki.com, which is not an allowed source, lists 'PCM (2 ch) 32 – 192 kHz'.

Whether the Marantz Model 50 has any digital input (search snippets say it is analog-only with an MM phono input). marantz.com/en-us and marantz.com/en-au both returned 404, and the distributor's spec PDF (hifidiprinzio.it) could not be read as text.

The WiiM Amp Pro's official spec page (wiimhome.com/wiimamppro/specs) and overview page came back as images with no readable text, so I could not get its rated power or minimum speaker impedance from WiiM.
Prices and minimum speaker impedance for each model: I did not check these because they fall outside the mechanism angle and the tool budget.
